5. TechSphere: ExitIQ already uses the Supabase 'newsletter-signup' function with double opt-in via Resend: reuse it, source 'Industrial Tech M&A 2026 Whitepaper'.
6. German copy and legal notices need approval.

Imagery: atares-tinted iStock set from SharePoint (MarCom › SCT Whitepaper › iStock › final) plus the handshake visual from 1.2.5 iStock and the ExitIQ dark gradient background. Logos and colour tokens come from the ExitIQ source.
